title: Can LLMs Solve My Grandma’s Riddle? Evaluating Multilingual Large Language Models on Reasoning Traditional Bangla Tricky Riddles
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models using a newly created benchmark of traditional Bengali riddles. It focuses on cultural grounding and figurative language rather than religious, faith-based, or ethical systems. The inclusion of an 'Ethical Considerations' section regarding data sourcing and human study participants does not qualify it as faith or ethics-related according to the provided instructions.
